phase6_correction.joint_velocity_root_cause: first-reset soft_joint_vel_limits were transiently zero before Articulation._apply_actuator_model

hypothesis: A Stage335 physical reset is not a valid recovery RSI unless episode clock, prior raw/effective action, gait phase, velocity-command event state, and the low-command moving latch are restored after Isaac Lab resets its managers.

implementation: episode clock and four-value gait phase reconstruction
raw policy action and prior issued action restoration
velocity command, standing mask, event timer, and bounded force-moving latch restoration

control.expected_behavior: strict no-op: no pending stateful payload and no modified clock/action/command buffers

source_report.action_contract: 15D lower/waist raw residual plus gait template, clipped before execution

contract_audit.important_finding: Twelve states have command magnitude <= 0.1 while the source gait phase is still moving; command threshold alone would silently change their action semantics.

tests.pure_unit_command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 PYTHONPATH=tools conda run -n x2-sonic-isaaclab python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_recovery_reset_curriculum.py tests/test_stop_recovery_states.py

source_to_isaac_projection.important_finding: The generic 0.9 contraction excludes the official/default zero pose for X2's asymmetric shoulder-roll limits. Matching the official hard limits removes the large 90/90 projection but does not resolve runtime joint-velocity mismatch.

official_matched_event_observational_gat.source: the five immutable Stage326 official AimDK v1.0 matched-event traces from which Stage335 was extracted
official_matched_event_observational_gat.what_it_proves: The selected states and eventual-pass labels have exact official matched-event provenance under one common 50 Hz/PD/observation/action contract.
official_matched_event_observational_gat.what_it_does_not_prove: It does not prove that resetting a fresh official MuJoCo process into one selected row reproduces the recorded continuation.

blocker.cause: After matching official hard limits, 6/90 source states still require a small left-shoulder-roll projection (max 0.000228 rad), reset-return joint velocities differ from source by up to 1.69701 rad/s, and the traces also omit the complete future brake feedback schedule plus lateral-supervisor/controller internal state.
blocker.why_a_normal_full_episode_rerun_is_not_a: It starts from the ordinary initial state and therefore tests frozen backend stochasticity, not the stateful reset injection contract.
required_to_unblock: retain the official hard-limit contract and handle the remaining 6 small shoulder-roll violations
locate and eliminate the reset-return joint-velocity mismatch
serialize the official controller/supervisor event state at every selected row, including brake/latch/slew state
add an isolated official runner that restores full qpos/qvel plus controller state before continuing
compare a source suffix and a restored suffix under deterministic matched control

conclusion: Phase6 supersedes the joint-velocity finding: the first-reset zero-limit bug is fixed and projected runtime q/dq plus logical state are exact. Raw source q still has six tiny hard-limit violations and old traces contain no controller state, so deterministic suffix equivalence and recovery training remain locked.
next: Resolve the remaining position-limit contract, then record new hashed physical plus controller snapshots and run deterministic source/restored suffix equivalence.
